about: Every triaged oracle difference (chapter 28.10), by signature: a nightly run fails only on a signature not here, and each ends as a fixture.

records.why: fiksi's answer meets every rule within its stopping residual but is another root of the sketch, tens of units from the drawn start (job 2324 of seed 000000099eaf7747, 35 units: a sketch of distances has mirrored solutions); the kernel stays on the drawn branch, as chapter 15.7's least change asks. Both are solutions.

fiksi stopped short of a solution: its answer misses rules by up to a third of a unit (job 2149 of seed 000000099eaf7747), where its Levenberg-Marquardt loop gives up after 100 steps or on a relative change below 10^-6, which its own comment there says may stall short of a root; the kernel meets every rule on the truth.
